description: Dark, intimate, and just mysterious enough. 🖤 Comala feels like stepping out of Portland for the evening. Mexico-forward cocktails, an incredible mezcal collection, beautiful storytelling, and an atmosphere made for lingering. Come curious. Let the bartender guide you. 📍 Comala 422 NW 8th Ave Portland, OR 97209 #PortlandOregon #PDXEats #PortlandBars #Mezcal #PortlandNightlife
